note: Licences of everything an ORBIS-GRAPHICS-PACK archive can contain. Arch Linux binary packages carry their own licence texts in /usr/share/licenses/<pkg>/ inside each .pkg.tar.zst; their exact list and versions are in pack-manifest.json.

components.name: orbis-graphics (diagnostics, qualification, profiles, integrator, stage-0 overlay, build wiring)
mesa-orbis-ps4, opencl-mesa-orbis-ps4, lib32-mesa-orbis-ps4, mesa-orbis-ps4-experimental
components.license: MIT and the per-file licences listed in Mesa's docs/license.rst

components.name: Mesa RustiCL Rust crates (vendored by meson at build time, hashes pinned by Mesa)
Arch Linux dependency closure (libdrm, llvm-libs, libclc, spirv-*, vulkan-icd-loader, ocl-icd, tools)
components.license: per package; see /usr/share/licenses inside each package

firmware: The pack contains no PS4 firmware (no GPU microcode, no Marvell Wi-Fi/Bluetooth firmware, no EDID, no keys). Images produced by the integrator keep whatever the Orbis 0.2.0 base image already carries, so integrated images inherit that image's private-use restriction.
